title: Thanking LSN Ce Pack [official]
description: This is a lifesteal.net texture pack, using it makes you able to see custom enchants and custom items on the server made by the official staff member [ Thanking ]
body:
#  Lifesteal.net LSN pack
This texture pack brings a fresh look to LSN with custom textures for armor, weapons and other stuff

In addition the pack includes: every single custom enchant, ender paper, enchant scroll,  ravager hide, heart, sell wand, spawners and poi keys + adds low shield![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53e7296a665d98a670e0d0e3efe721eb937bb42b.png)
# Depended on [Variants-CIT](https://modrinth.com/mod/variants-cit/versions) 5.4.1+

if you wanna dowload different variants of the pack then its at the versions session
